title: Choosing What to Collect: Deliberate Selection Against Indiscriminate Pulling, and a Source-Checked Delineation of Open Archives to Pick, Hold, Refuse and Retire
description:
Aaron Michael Weis proposes choosing public research data against a stated goal. The paper compares archive policies and describes decisions to collect narrowly, hold, decline, or propose retirement. Six statements were matched to exact text from publisher or maintainer pages. A synthetic benchmark reproduced across 720 cases. The four proposed tests of dataset selection remain unrun.

Aaron Michael Weis conducted the research and directed the paper. Claude (Anthropic) assisted with drafting and source checks. Codex (OpenAI) prepared the public edition and reran the evidence tools.
